SongComments.SongComment: This small tutorial shows another usage of the delay column. By putting very small, kind of random, delay values on your drums, you can make them feel a bit more natural (human). The changes are subtle, so listen carefully.

This example also shows, beside the note delays, a trick to make hihats a bit more interesting by playing them with small 0S sample offset effects. See the "HiHat" track in the "Humanized1+2" patterns.
